bio.text: Saritha Komatireddy is the Republican nominee for New York State Attorney General in the November 2026 election, running against Democratic incumbent Letitia James.
NY1 reports she was born in Brooklyn to parents who emigrated from India in the 1980s, is a Harvard Law graduate, and lives on the Upper East Side.

She clerked for Brett Kavanaugh when he was on the U.S. Court of Appeals, served as an assistant U.S. attorney who led terrorism, cybercrime and other prosecutions, and was chief of staff of the Drug Enforcement Administration.
